title: Beyond English: Unveiling Multilingual Bias in LLM Copyright Compliance

bias_targets.methodology: Direct probing of language models for copyrighted song lyrics across four languages (English, Chinese, French, and Korean) using prompts in those same languages. The evaluation measures verbatim reproduction using Longest Common Substring (LCS) and ROUGE-L, as well as the model's Refusal Rate and Hallucination Rate.
